subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding request — PilotEdge pilot (3mo)
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: PilotEdge — onboarding / PO question (pilot invoice-only ask)

Folks, forwarding a request from PilotEdge. They want to run a 3-month pilot (est. $18k total) but their procurement process won’t issue a PO for trials — they invoice instead. Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding with Net30 terms, conditioned on receiving W-9 and SOW.

Attachments: pilot_scope_statement.pdf (external SOW), PilotEdge_W9.pdf, PilotEdge_Invoicing_Instructions.docx

Could Procurement/Finance weigh in on whether we can make a short-term exception and what safeguards we should require? I’ve highlighted proposed guardrails below.

Proposed guardrails
- 3-month maximum pilot period; finance to place a hold if invoices exceed $20k
- Signed SOW (attached) must specify deliverables and termination
- W-9 and remittance instructions on file
- Payment terms: Net30; no consumption beyond agreed cap unless billing approved

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0143

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@pilotedge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:43:12 -0700
Subject: PilotEdge pilot — invoicing approach
Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick chat today. PilotEdge is excited to move forward with a small production-sim pilot for three months. Our procurement team will not issue a PO for pilots; the only viable path for us is invoice-based. I attached our W-9 and an invoice-instruction doc.

We can do Net30 and confirm total pilot spend will not exceed $20k. Happy to sign the SOW and any onboarding paperwork you need.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Partnerships, PilotEdge
samantha@pilotedge.com


-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:04:35 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: PilotEdge — onboarding / PO question (pilot invoice-only ask)
Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the packet. Procurement policy is clear that POs are required for standard onboarding, but we do have a documented exception path for low-risk pilots. To proceed we'll need:

1) Completed onboarding checklist (vendor intake) with risk tier set to 'low' — Chloe can run this
2) SOW signed and timeboxed (the attached SOW looks okay; please ensure Section 3 has explicit termination language)
3) W-9 and remittance instructions on file (PilotEdge attached)
Operational controls I recommend:
- Finance to create an invoice-only vendor record with pilot flag; set automated alert at $15k
- Contract to include a cap and auto-suspend clause if invoices exceed approved amount
If Procurement & Finance agree we can approve as a temporary exception. Karthik — can you confirm we can set the $15k alert and create the vendor record? Chloe — please start the intake form and draft the vendor notes.
Marissa
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com


-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 12:37:02 +0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: PilotEdge — onboarding / PO question (pilot invoice-only ask)
We can set the vendor up as "invoice-only" in AP and enable an alert at $15k. Finance will require an approval workflow for any invoice that would push the total over the approved cap. Also propose we require a quick credit check (internal scoring) because we occasionally see delayed payments from small partners; that can be a one-line risk note on the vendor record.

I can implement the vendor record tomorrow morning once Chloe marks the intake form as complete.

—Karthik
Director, Finance Operations
karthik.iyer@redwood.com


-----
From: PilotEdge Finance <invoices@pilotedge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@pilotedge.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:19:50 -0700
Subject: RE: Invoicing details for Redwood pilot
Hi Naomi,

Confirming PilotEdge can invoice Redwood with Net30. Please advise how Redwood would like invoices routed (AP email vs vendor portal). Attached is a sample invoice template if that helps.
Thanks,
PilotEdge Finance
invoices@pilotedge.com
Attachment: sample_invoice.xlsx

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@pilotedge.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 22:45:00 +0000
Subject: Approved: temporary invoice-only onboarding (PilotEdge)
Hi team,
Procurement + Finance have approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for PilotEdge under the following conditions: 
- Pilot duration capped at 3 months from effective date
- Total invoiced amount must not exceed $20,000; Finance will block payments above $15,000 and require express approval to release the hold
- Signed SOW on file and W-9 collected (received)
- Vendor record will be created as "invoice-only (pilot)" and flagged for a credit note
Samantha — please route invoices to ap-payments@redwood.com and include the PilotEdge invoice number in the subject line. Also confirm the remittance address on the attached invoicing instructions.
Chloe — please create the intake record and set the vendor risk to low; Karthik — create the invoice-only vendor and add the $15k alert. Naomi — continue with onboarding and confirm start date with PilotEdge once the record is in place.
I'll follow up after the intake and vendor record are created. Thanks all.
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment stubs: pilot_scope_statement.pdf, PilotEdge_W9.pdf, PilotEdge_Invoicing_Instructions.docx, sample_invoice.xlsx]
